# CheckMate PDI Exxpert (checkmatepdi.com)

## About
CheckMate PDI Exxpert is an independent car Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) and pre-purchase inspection service operating across Mumbai, Thane, Navi Mumbai, and the Kalyan-Dombivli belt in Maharashtra, India. The company provides unbiased, buyer-first vehicle evaluations to detect hidden accident damage, repainted panels, mechanical issues, odometer fraud, and electrical faults before buyers make final payments or sign handover documents.

## Pricing
- Starting Price: ₹999
- Transparent pricing with no hidden charges.

## Services Offered
1. Car Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI): 350+ point inspection performed at dealer showrooms or yards prior to car registration and delivery.
2. Pre-Purchase Used Car Inspection: Comprehensive technical check for used cars including body paint depth measurement, chassis verification, engine bay fluid analysis, OBD diagnostics, and road testing review.

## Key Features & Highlights
- 350+ Checkpoint Checklist across 11 key categories.
- High-resolution photo and video evidence attached to every report item.
- Digital decision-ready report delivered via WhatsApp and Email within 15 minutes of inspection completion.
- Paint Thickness Gauge testing to detect hidden accident repairs and body fillers.
- Independent service: 100% buyer-focused with zero dealer pressure or sales bias.

## Service Areas Covered
- Mumbai Western Line: Churchgate, Marine Lines, Charni Road, Grant Road, Mumbai Central, Mahalaxmi, Lower Parel, Prabhadevi, Dadar, Mahim, Bandra, Khar, Santacruz, Vile Parle, Andheri, Jogeshwari, Goregaon, Malad, Kandivali, Borivali, Dahisar, Mira Road, Bhayandar, Naigaon, Vasai Road, Nallasopara, Virar.
- Thane Corridor: Thane West, Thane East, Ghodbunder Road, Majiwada, Vartak Nagar, Pokhran Road, Kalwa, Mumbra.
- Kalyan-Dombivli Belt: Diva, Kopar, Dombivli, Thakurli, Kalyan East, Kalyan West.
- Navi Mumbai.
